items.title: Remains of medieval king Czar Samuel arrive in Bulgaria after decades of talks with Greece
items.author: Associated Press
items.content:
<article>The remains of medieval Bulgarian ruler Czar Samuel arrived in Bulgaria on Saturday, after decades of negotiations with neighbouring Greece. Samuel was a warrior ruler who battled the Byzantine Empire to expand his kingdom but was ultimately defeated and died shortly afterwards in 1014. He is considered a symbol of Bulgaria’s national identity.

items.title: At least 17, most of them Catholic pilgrims, killed in a road crash on a highway in Kenya
items.author: Associated Press
items.content:
<article>A crash involving multiple vehicles on a highway to the Kenyan coastal city of Mombasa on Saturday killed 17 people, most of them pilgrims on the way to a prayer site, officials said. The crash in the Salama area happened after midnight when a truck driver tried and failed to overtake another truck, which caused a collision with vehicles including a van carrying pilgrims, police said. (AP Video by Andrew Kasuku)

items.author: Associated Press
items.content:

items.title: One shot or two? What to know about HPV vaccination recommendations
items.author: Associated Press
items.content:
<article>Medical experts are discussing the possibility that one dose of a life-saving cancer vaccine, instead of two, may be enough to protect young people from human papillomavirus, the most common sexually transmitted infection in the U.S.
